deviations.description: Rule C is applied with a ~3 Gy tolerance: when the cord goal is below the anatomical floor by less than about 3 Gy (and no other rule applies), layer-1 cord units 4, 6 and 9 stay at zero because their biases are shifted by ~3 Gy, so the network sends the request to automated planning instead of escalating.
deviations.condition: (cord_floor > cord_lim) and (cord_floor < cord_lim + 3) and (missing == 0) and not (cov > cap) and not ((mand_in_ptv - 0.05 * ptv_vol > 0.1) and (cov > mand_lim))
